history.summary: A 1,389 sqft 4BR at Nuovo (D20 Yio Chu Kang, 99yr from 2004) at $1.98M / $1,425 PSF, well-located 480m from Yio Chu Kang MRT. Aging leasehold with ~77 years left and no URA appreciation data; decent location but unexciting fundamentals.
history.rating_rationale: 22-year-old 99yr leasehold means ~77yrs remaining — lease decay starts to weigh on financing and resale over a 5-7yr hold. $1,425 PSF is fair for D20 but appreciation will be capped by the depreciating lease and OCR-baseline growth. 480m MRT walk and ~$2M family quantum support liquidity, but score_1000 469 and no catalysts make this a hold-not-buy.

history.summary: High-floor 1,422 sqft unit at Nuovo (former EC, 297 units, TOP 2004, 99yr from May 2001 → ~74yr left) asking $1.98M / $1,392 psf. Own recent prints: 1,421 sqft $1.94M ($1,365, 31 Aug 2026), 1,389 sqft $1.939M ($1,396, Aug 2026) and $1.93M ($1,390, Jun 2026); 12-mo range ~$1,141–1,396 psf. Ask sits at the top of the same-size print band (~2% over the latest identical-size sale) and is the priciest of ~5 competing same-size listings in the DB ($1.91–1.98M). Fair value ≈ $1.92–1.94M.
history.rating_rationale: Solid, liquid, never-lost-money project but no value edge at this ask. The −19.6% 'cheap vs age-adjusted D20 peers' is largely a format artifact: Nuovo is a privatised EC (64% HDB-upgrader buyers, lease started 2001 not 2004) and structurally trades below private condos — its own 2026 prints are the true comp, and the ask is at/above the top of them (1,421 sqft sold $1.94M on 31 Aug 2026). Rent is overstated by the model ($5,930 district-bedroom vs realsmart median $4,535 → ~2.8–2.9% gross, not 3.6%). REALSCORE 3.6 / 99.6% profitable on 286 resale pairs is strong downside evidence, but much of it was earned off subsidised EC launch prices a resale buyer today doesn't get. OCR region, 400m to Yio Chu Kang NSL and deep upgrader pool support exit liquidity. Would move toward Buy only at ≤ ~$1.88M (≈$1,320 psf, the 12-mo median). Mandate: over 'his' $1.8M cap; fits 'hers' budget but as a fairly-priced, not cheap, unit.
red_flags: Ask $1,392 psf is at the top of Nuovo's own 12-mo print range and ~2% above the latest same-size sale ($1.94M, 1,421 sqft, 31 Aug 2026)
Leasehold from May 2001: ~74yr left now, ~67yr at a 7-yr exit — decay steepening into the sale
Model rent overstated: district-bedroom $5,930 vs project median $4,535 (realsmart, 12 contracts) → gross yield ~2.8–2.9%
Competing supply: ~5 other same-size Nuovo listings at $1.91–1.98M — this is the priciest
Relative-value discount vs D20 private peers is an EC-format artifact, not a real edge
No URA-CSV prints in the repo (EC excluded) — relied on realsmart public prints
catalysts: 398m to Yio Chu Kang NSL MRT; Lentor TEL ~700m
Deep HDB-upgrader buyer pool (64% of buyers) — good exit liquidity
REALSCORE 3.6, 99.6% profitable on 286 resale pairs, avg ~5.1%/yr, 9.1yr avg hold

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Project median rent $4,535 (range $3,850–4,900, ~$3.39 psf/mo, 12–15 contracts) → ~$4.6–4.8k for this size, gross ~2.8–2.9%, net ~1.5%. Carry, not a thesis.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Median psf rose ~$889 (2019) → ~$1,334 (2026) — bull-regime trailing, de-weighted. Forward: OCR regional baseline ~3.7–4.2% less lease decay on a 22yr-old leasehold; buying at the top of the print band eats ~2–3% of it up front. No override applied.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No profile; listing says High Floor only. 1,389/1,421 sqft are the project's large 3BR/4BR-ish layouts (prior listings of the same size were labelled 4BR); bed_bands unknown. High floor justifies at most a small premium over the $1.94M same-size print.
